title: INZONE Profile Studio

profiles.name: Amber Hinge + Rose
profiles.summary: Green writing, amber Win/Fn and rose Shift keys.
profiles.tell: Amber Win/Fn plus rose Shift keys

profiles.name: Amber Hinge
profiles.summary: Green writing with an amber Win/Fn pair.
profiles.acceptance: Physically accepted as a simpler alternative.

profiles.name: Jade Exchange
profiles.summary: Green writing, mint landmarks, azure navigation and a violet frame.
profiles.tell: Green writing, mint landmarks, azure navigation and a violet frame.

profiles.name: Rose Shift
profiles.summary: A green field with a mirrored rose Shift pair.
profiles.acceptance: Perceptible and liked, but very subtle in the physical trial.

profiles.name: Moonlit Jade
profiles.summary: Aqua-jade writing with citron numbers and brackets.
profiles.acceptance: Retained as an experiment; green writing was preferred for daily use.

profiles.name: Orchid Gates
profiles.summary: Pink-orchid Tab and Enter in the familiar violet frame.
profiles.acceptance: The added distinction was barely perceptible in the physical trial.

profiles.name: Paired Amber Contrast
profiles.summary: Green writing with orange Ctrl and yellow Alt in an amber frame.
profiles.acceptance: The wider orange/yellow distinction was visible in the daylight trial.
profiles.tell: Green writing with orange Ctrl and yellow Alt in an amber frame.

profiles.name: Azure Exchange
profiles.summary: Azure writing and green arrows beneath a warm function row.
profiles.acceptance: Readable and harmonious in the trial; green writing was later preferred.
profiles.tell: Azure writing and green arrows beneath a warm function row.

profiles.name: Orchid Merge
profiles.summary: Green writing, violet command keys and an orchid function-row crown.
profiles.acceptance: Retained reference; the frame and crown felt too similar.
profiles.tell: Green writing, violet command keys and an orchid function-row crown.
